response.overview: The final showdown arrives as the decades-long war between Billy Butcher and Homelander reaches its apocalyptic endgame. With the world on the brink of total corporate and superhuman control, The Boys must risk everything for one last desperate strike against Vought International. Secrets are exposed, alliances crumble, and blood is spilled in the series-defining conclusion to the global phenomenon.
response.tagline: The final showdown. The ultimate bloodlust.
response.title: The Boys Finale Global Screening
